title: Maximum affine spaces of bent Boolean functions
summary: Determine the largest dimension of an affine space of bent Boolean functions in every even dimension.

formal_statement.body: For every positive even integer $n$, determine the maximum dimension of an affine space of bent Boolean functions on $\mathbb F_2^n$. Give matching upper bounds and constructions.

scope.domain: Affine spaces of bent Boolean functions
assumptions: Every function in the affine space is bent under the source definition
scope.unresolved_remainder: The exact maximum dimension for every even n, including matching constructions and upper bounds.
